title: Trilegal, CMS INDUSLAW act on Iswarya Fertility Center securing $37 million investment from OrbiMed
description: Iswarya Fertility Center has secured a primary investment of $37 million from OrbiMed Asia VI Mauritius Limited, an investment vehicle of OrbiMed.Trilegal advised Iswarya Health Private Limited (the parent company of Iswarya Fetility Center), and its promoters, Dr. Arun Muthuvel, Dr. S. Chandralekha and Dr. K. Veluswamy, on this transaction.The transaction was led by Rahul Chugh (Partner), with support from Kriti Chatrath (Senior Associate) and Samridhi Poddar (Associate).Rahul ChughCMS INDUSLAW
